note: Defaults for the netback calculator. Every value is user-editable on the site. Sources and verification notes: data/assumptions_sources.md. henryHub and eurusd are refreshed daily by the pipeline; the values here are fallbacks.

henryHub.label: Henry Hub spot
henryHub.source: EIA, Henry Hub Natural Gas Spot Price (series RNGWHHD), API v2

ttf.label: TTF front-month
ttf.source: Manual. Indicative round level from public press reports of the Dec-26 contract (EUR 85 to 86/MWh). Not a licensed assessment.

jkm.label: North Asia spot LNG (JKM proxy)
jkm.source: Manual. Indicative round level from public press reports of the weekly North-east Asia spot LNG average for January delivery ($26.90/MMBtu). Not a licensed assessment.

eurusd.label: EUR/USD
eurusd.source: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rate

charterRate.label: Charter rate (174k m3, two-stroke, Atlantic spot)
charterRate.source: Public weekly shipping commentary: Atlantic two-stroke $38,400/day (week 45) and $33,200/day (week 46), 2026

vesselSize.label: Vessel cargo capacity
vesselSize.source: Industry standard newbuild size (IIR, 'The future standard for energy-saving LNG carriers')

mmbtuPerM3.label: Conversion factor
mmbtuPerM3.source: 0.45 t/m3 LNG density x 52 MMBtu/t (common industry factors). Gasgrid Finland conversion table gives 24.02 (+2.6%).

boilOff.label: Boil-off rate (laden)
boilOff.source: Modern membrane carrier benchmark 0.085%/day (Gas Carrier Update 2015, Univ. Hamburg); Argus cites 0.08%/day for a typical two-stroke carrier

speed.label: Vessel speed
speed.source: Implied by Kpler voyage times (via MET Group, 2023): 22 days via Panama, 35 via Suez, 38 via Cape, which equal 17.2 to 17.4 knots on the distances below

panamaFee.label: Panama Canal fee
panamaFee.source: Panama Canal Authority tolls page: Neopanamax LNG fixed $300,000/transit + $2.05/m3 capacity, ballast 85% of tolls, mandatory Neopanamax tug $30,000. Average of laden and ballast for 174,000 m3.

suezFee.label: Suez Canal fee
suezFee.source: Nominal LNG carrier toll about $397,000 (Argus table, undated) plus SCA temporary surcharge for LNG carriers raised to 19% from 15 July 2026. Rebates for US Gulf to Asia vary. Low confidence.

portCosts.label: Port and other costs
portCosts.source: US Gulf load port under $70,000/call (Wood Mackenzie via Riviera, 2025) plus discharge port about $150,000 to $250,000 (Platts port-cost notes, 2024), plus agency and sundries

liquefactionFee.label: Liquefaction fee
liquefactionFee.source: Cheniere Q4 2025 call: pricing above midpoint of $2.50 to $3.00 range (via S&P Global, 2026); Argus Dec 2025 indicative benchmark $3.00

feedgasMultiplier.label: Feedgas multiplier
feedgasMultiplier.source: Cheniere Sabine Pass SPAs: 115% of Henry Hub plus fixed fee (SEC filings)

routes.label: NW Europe (TTF), direct
routes.source: Sabine Pass to Gravelines 5,152 nm (Sealagom) plus about 150 nm to Rotterdam; ports.com gives 5,657 nm

routes.label: North Asia (JKM) via Panama
routes.source: Sabine Pass to Tokyo via Panama, 9,209 nm (Riviera Maritime Media); S&P Global gives 9,214 nm

routes.label: North Asia (JKM) via Suez
routes.source: Sabine Pass to Tokyo via Suez, 14,521 nm (Riviera, citing sea-distances.org); S&P Global gives about 14,500

routes.label: North Asia (JKM) via Cape of Good Hope
routes.source: Sabine Pass to Tokyo via Cape of Good Hope, 15,689 nm (S&P Global, 2016)
